✅ **All tests pass!** The fix was successful.

The bug was in line 14 of `invoicing/money.py`: the function was extracting the negative sign but never applying it to the result. I changed:

```python
return paise
```

to:

```python
return -paise if neg else paise
```

Now `to_paise("-20.50")` correctly returns `-2050` instead of `2050`. All 10 tests pass, including the existing money tests.
